wave: M17 W2C-VR — Bounded Control Flow Browser Visual Review
method: Chrome that qua CDP; viewport dat TRUOC khi trang dung; fixture di qua CHINH validateProgramSpec + runProgram cua san pham (khong co engine fixture song song). Nguoi xem toan bo PNG cham; assertion chi ho tro.

vr-cf1-assignment.note: Chuong trinh MOT cau lenh: buoc 0 chinh la cau lenh duy nhat, nen mo len da thay y=7. Khong co gi SAI (snapshot dung cua buoc do) va vet vao ra 'y: 0 -> 7' nay lam phep tinh quan sat duoc, nhung hoc sinh khong co buoc TRUOC khi chay. Sua triet de = them mot buoc tien-thuc-thi vao trace = doi executor -> NGOAI pham vi VR.

vr-cf2-if-else.note: Dieu kien 'x > 0 -> SAI' co CHU (khong chi mau). Chi nhanh nguoc lai chay; y=1 khong bao gio xuat hien.

vr-cf3-while.note: Kiem dieu kien / vao than / cap nhat bien / thoat vong lap la CAC BUOC RIENG. Luot 1-4 ro; x=5 chi hien o buoc thoat tro di.

vr-cf4-boolean.note: 'a va khong (b)' doc duoc; bien luan ly hien 'dung'/'sai' khop ma gia sau VR4.

vr-cf8-iteration-limit.note: Buoc cuoi KHONG noi 'ket thuc' ma noi 'chua ket thuc trong gioi han mo phong'; controls van chay; x=5 KHONG duoc goi la dap an.

vr-cf5-insufficient.note: Tieu de 'CHUA DU DU KIEN'; doi bien ban dau + dieu kien + than vong lap; KHONG hien chuong trinh mau; khong lo ma loi/target id.

vr-cf6-unsupported-function.note: Noi ro chua ho tro ham/de quy va goi y dung pham vi; khong generic fallback; khong hien chuong trinh cat do.

vr-cf7-invalid-variable.note: Noi bien duoc dung khi chua co gia tri ban dau; khong lo duong dan validator/enum.

coverage_gaps: Panel bien (Inspector) o 768px nam sau nut 'Quan sat' cua app shell — hanh vi CHUNG cua moi domain, khong phai dac thu W2C. Chua danh gia trong wave nay.
Prediction/what-if chua co nen khong co tieu chi thi giac tuong ung.
measurement_artefacts: Assertion `condition_has_words` dung \b(DUNG|SAI)\b: ky tu 'D' co gach ngang KHONG phai word-char trong regex JS nen ca hien 'DUNG' bi bao False. ANH CHUNG MINH chu co that (vd vr-cf3 mid_iteration). Day la ARTEFACT PHEP DO, khong phai loi san pham.
Assertion `notice_title` bat nham h2 'Goi y kham pha' cua muc goi y ben duoi. ANH cho thay tieu de that la 'CHUA DU DU KIEN'. Cung la artefact selector.
